registryEvidence.basis: Bhulekh and BhuNaksha are public Odisha/NIC land-record and cadastral-map services. Live BhuNaksha level discovery returned Bhadrak district (code 16), Bhadrak tehsil (code 2), and a Bhadrak village entry (Odia value bhadrak, code 10). This establishes a local/state cadastral map custodian, not a verified vector parcel feed.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Odisha state land-record/cadastral map service with Bhadrak district, tehsil, village, RI, and sheet selectors.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Bhadrak district/tehsil/village selector presence and WMS-backed map extent were observed; citywide parcel completeness and a public ID-plus-geometry response were not verified.

remainingUncertainty: The viewer exposes raster/WMS map presentation and plot lookup workflows, but no bounded anonymous vector response with safe native parcel identity and geometry was captured. Exact-point hits, map extent, and viewer limitations do not establish citywide absence.
